title: Fixed-degree exactness for bounded-above flat tensor complexes
statement: Under the hypotheses of [lem-pc-bounded-above-flat-tensor-acyclic], for every integer n the total tensor complex is exact at degree n.

source.place: Lemma 06YQ, bounded-above case: fixed total degree truncation and spectral sequence

proof.text: Fix n, truncate the bounded-above complexes below the finite diagonal range affecting degrees n-1,n,n+1, translate the resulting bounded double complex to the first quadrant, and apply the first-quadrant double-complex spectral-sequence convergence theorem. Filter by the P-degree; flatness makes every column acyclic, so the E1 page and hence the finite filtration of degree-n cohomology vanish.
